input: Set the air conditioner temperature in the master bedroom to 19 degrees.

contexts: The night air feels stagnant despite the clock inching closer to midnight, leaving the room feeling warmer than comforting against the cotton sheets.
A bead of sweat forms on the brow uncomfortably within minutes of lying down, making it hard to drift into slumber.
The gentle hum from outside is the only sound breaking the palpable thickness in the air as the warm night envelops the room.
A restless toss and turn continue as the gentle breeze from the outside seems to have completely stalled, causing a sense of warmth to linger.
